 For the State : Mr. F. Allam, App

04/ 20.02.2023.

Petitioner above-named who is in custody since 14.10.2022 has moved this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Manjhiaon P.S. Case No.196 of 2022 corresponding to POCSO Case No.102 of 2022 registered under Sections 376/ 506/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 4 of POCSO Act.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence and he has been falsely implicated in this case.

It is further submitted that the main allegation is against one Dinesh Rajwar that he had enticed the victim-girl on a motorcycle and had committed rape upon her.
It is however, submitted that the prosecutrix in her statement under Section 164 Cr. P.C. has stated that she along with one Dinesh Rajwar had gone with her own accord and has not supported the case of the prosecution and accordingly, the main accused, Dinesh Rajwar has been granted bail by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court.
Learned APP for the State
Considering the submissions of learned counsel and the fact as discussed above, the bail application is allowed.

Accordingly, the petitioner named above shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Court below.
